title: How Do VLMs Behave When Blind or Misled? Behavioral Evaluation of VLMs on Scientific Figures
abstract: arXiv:2608.13267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks emphasize perception and reasoning accuracy (how well VLMs describe and reason about what they see in an image), with limited attention to behavioral reliability under uncertainty (how they behave when visual evidence is missing or misleading). We introduce SciFigBench, a diagnostic VLM benchmark for scientific figure understanding that jointly evaluates perception, reasoning, and behavioral reliability under uncertainty. It contains 250 figures with high-quality human annotations across three evaluation aspects, totaling 600+ hours of annotation effort. We further extend these figures via image transformations, reasoning questions, resistance probes, caption-bias probes, and confirmed selective-blur targets, producing over 34,000 evaluation setups for stress testing. translated_title: 视觉语言模型在盲目或被误导时如何表现？对科学图表上视觉语言模型的行为评估
translated_abstract: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）基准测试主要强调感知和推理准确性（即模型如何准确描述和推理图像中的内容），而对不确定性下的行为可靠性（即当视觉证据缺失或具有误导性时模型如何表现）关注有限。我们引入了SciFigBench，一个针对科学图表理解的诊断性VLM基准测试，它联合评估了感知、推理以及不确定性下的行为可靠性。该基准包含250个图表，配有高质量人工标注，涵盖三个评估方面，总计超过600小时的标注工作量。我们进一步通过图像变换、推理问题、抵抗性探针、标题偏差探针以及确认的选择性模糊目标来扩展这些图表，生成超过34,000个评估设置用于压力测试。我们还提出了Admittance-Resistance-Inductance（A-R-I）框架，以评估模型是否承认证据不足。
tldr: 本文提出了SciFigBench基准和A-R-I框架，用于系统评估视觉语言模型在科学图表理解中面对缺失或误导性视觉信息时的行为可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SciFigBench and the A-R-I framework to systematically evaluate the behavioral reliability of vision-language models when facing missing or misleading visual information in scientific figure understanding.
